items.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
items.description: The US military says it struck Iranian drones and radar sites. Tehran responds by targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

items.title: Putin says there is 'no point' meeting Zelensky over ending Ukraine war
items.description: The Russian president's refusal comes after his Ukrainian counterpart wrote an open letter calling for face-to-face talks.

items.title: Rumours and speculation as fans forecast date of Taylor Swift's wedding
items.description: Swifties worldwide are looking for clues about the superstar's nuptials to American football star Travis Kelce.

items.title: Armenia braces for election as Russia piles pressure on pro-West government
items.description: Incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is seeking a third term despite falling domestic support.

items.title: Iran's football team granted visas to enter US for World Cup, officials say
items.description: The approval comes just 10 days before the Iranian squad's opening match against New Zealand in Los Angeles.

items.title: Canada bans Texas cattle over flesh-eating screwworm outbreak in US
items.description: The ban came as a second infected calf was identified in Texas, and the US state declaring a state of disaster over the outbreak.

items.title: Tributes to Buffy and Ted Lasso star Anthony Head who dies aged 72
items.description: The British actor, who also appeared in Merlin and Little Britain, died of complications from pneumonia.

items.title: Palestinian baby killed by Israeli gunfire in West Bank, health ministry says
items.description: The Israeli military says Friday's "incident is under review", expressing "deep sorrow for any harm caused".

items.title: Nearly 50 people die of thirst in Sahara desert after lorry breaks down
items.description: Only two survived after trekking more than 50km (30 miles) across the desert to alert the authorities.

items.title: US stocks slump as fears over Big Tech shake Wall Street
items.description: The Nasdaq saw its biggest daily fall since early 2025.

items.title: Ukraine strikes cargo ships and admits Romania drone blast
items.description: Ukraine says it struck five ships carrying illegal cargo in the Sea of Azov and in coastal waters of Russian-occupied territories.

items.title: Astronauts return to ISS after sheltering during air leak repair attempt
items.description: Russian attempt to repair tunnel area sparks safe-haven procedure for five other astronauts onboard.
